description: Change animations of a rigged .glb as afk.ai/rig's Adjust > Animation does, and write a new .glb: turn parts of the body (controls such as armsUp, posture, headUp in degrees), change how it moves (speed, motion, bounce, sway, lag, lookAhead, width, lift, part:arms...), move a hand, foot or the body (positions, the limb reaching for it), and for humans keep the arms out of the body. inspect_rig lists the controls this body type has, with their ranges. Reports each changed animation's ground [before, after] (and arms-through-body frames with keep_arms_out). Runs on this computer, free.

animations.description: the animations to change: all (default) or names

controls.description: control id -> value, e.g. {"armsUp": 15, "speed": 1.2}. Turns are degrees; movement multiplies (1 leaves it) except lag (seconds), lookAhead (0-1) and width (model units)

file.description: a rigged .glb (absolute, or relative to the server's working directory): one rig_model wrote, or any model on afk.ai's skeletons

keep_arms_out.description: humans: turn the arms, spine and neck as little as possible so arms and hands stay out of the body (1: all of the correction)

output.description: where to write the result (default: the next free <model>-v2.glb, -v3... beside it; never the input)

pole.description: moves the elbow or knee (model units)

space.description: offsets along the world (root) or turning with the hips (default for hands and feet)

positions.description: hand_l, foot_r... or body: moved by an offset, the limb bending to reach it (feet stay planted)

ranges.description: only part of each animation for a control or position id (seconds), eased in and out

type.description: the body type, when it can't be told from the file (afk.ai's files say)

name: adjust_animation
